title.zh: 代码共同方案的全局支持
title.en: Global support of coded joint plans

statement.en: A plan realized at a description is supported at every configuration it describes where configurations the description identifies match parts into configurations it identifies, the leaves are read correctly through it, and footprints are within and apart.
statement.zh: 凡描述所认同的构形把部分匹配到它所认同的构形、叶经它被正确读出、足迹在内且相离，一个在描述处被实现的计划在它所描述的每个构形处被支持。

laws.en: A configuration's footprint supports a list where the list repeats nothing and each member lies within the footprint; footprints are within where each part a whole holds has its footprint within the whole's, and apart where the two parts a whole holds share nothing of their footprints. What a plan's leaves draw on is joined leaf by leaf, in order.
laws.zh: 一个构形的足迹支持一个列表，是指该列表不重复，且每个成员都在足迹之内；足迹在内，是指整体所持的每个部分的足迹都在整体的足迹之内；足迹相离，是指整体所持的两个部分的足迹没有共同之处。计划的叶所汲取者按叶依次接合。

laws.en: For any ternary joint relation, footprint and description: where configurations the description identifies match parts into ones it identifies, footprints are within and apart, and leaves are read through the description exactly as support, a plan realized at a configuration's description, under the joint relation read through it, has what its leaves draw on supported by that configuration's footprint.
laws.zh: 对任意三元共同关系、足迹与描述：凡该描述所认同的构形把部分匹配到它所认同的构形、足迹在内且相离、叶经描述恰被读作支持，一个在构形之描述处（经该描述读出的共同关系之下）被实现的计划，其叶所汲取者由该构形的足迹支持。

laws.en: In a joint frame, through a code reading the joint tests exactly and giving one code to configurations passing the same ones: where the pairs of parts held are compact for the joint tests, each joint test holds wherever it cannot fail, footprints are within and apart, and leaves are read through the code exactly as support, a plan realized at a configuration's code has its leaves' draws supported by its footprint.
laws.zh: 在共同框架中，经一个精确读出共同检验、并给通过相同检验之构形同一编码的编码：凡所持的部分之对对共同检验紧致、每个共同检验在不能不成立处成立、足迹在内且相离、叶经编码恰被读作支持，一个在构形之编码处被实现的计划，其叶所汲取者由该构形的足迹支持。

laws.en: Support at the root need not give realization, in a witness: where no whole holds any part, the footprint of the one configuration supports what a plan of two empty leaves draws on, and the plan is not realized.
laws.zh: 根处的支持不必给出实现，见证：没有整体持有任何部分时，唯一构形的足迹支持一个由两片空叶组成的计划所汲取者，而该计划不被实现。

hypotheses.en: Description form: any ternary joint relation on configurations of any kind, any footprint and any description; matching of parts through the description (MatchesParts), footprints of parts within the whole's (PartsWithin) and apart (PartsApart), and leaves read correctly as support (Supports).
hypotheses.zh: 描述形式：任意类型构形上的任意三元共同关系、任意足迹与任意描述；经描述的部分匹配（MatchesParts）、部分足迹在整体之内（PartsWithin）且相离（PartsApart），叶被正确读作支持（Supports）。

hypotheses.en: Code form: a joint frame of the spine and a code of its joint tests, with JointCompact, TestsStable, Exact and Reduced, which give the matching of parts through the code, and PartsWithin, PartsApart and leaves read correctly as support.
hypotheses.zh: 编码形式：脊柱的共同框架与其共同检验的编码，带 JointCompact、TestsStable、Exact 与 Reduced（它们给出经编码的部分匹配），以及 PartsWithin、PartsApart 与叶被正确读作支持。

does_not_show.en: Support is shown where the two parts a whole holds have footprints apart; where their footprints overlap it is not shown.
does_not_show.zh: 只在整体所持两个部分的足迹相离时表明支持；足迹重叠时不表明。

does_not_show.en: Support at the root does not give realization: the converse needs conditions beyond footprints within and apart.
does_not_show.zh: 根处的支持不给出实现：逆方向需要足迹在内且相离之外的条件。

validation_scope.en: Machine-checked by the consolidated Lean 4.29.1 checker (check_becoming.py): the current bytes of the core modules Becoming.Composition, Becoming.JointCorrespondence and Becoming.JointPlans are bound to core receipts under becoming-checks/; every cited declaration has an empty axiom report. The periphery ExplanatoryFootprints and the retired CompositionBridge are provenance; their receipt under explanatory-global-realization-checks keeps its earlier scope.
validation_scope.zh: Lean 4.29.1 合并检查器（check_becoming.py）实查：核心模块 Composition、JointCorrespondence 与 JointPlans 的当前字节绑定 becoming-checks/ 下的核心回执；所引声明的公理报告均为空。外围 ExplanatoryFootprints 与退役的 CompositionBridge 是来源，其 explanatory-global-realization-checks 回执保持原范围。

next_delta.en: State what a realized plan's leaves draw on where the parts' footprints overlap, counted with its repetitions, and find the conditions under which support at the root gives realization.
next_delta.zh: 陈述部分足迹重叠时被实现计划的叶所汲取者（连同其重复计数），并找出根处的支持给出实现的条件。

correspondence.en: This is formal composition within the same model and leaf reading, not a general translation to additive amounts drawn on or to arbitrary temporal models.
correspondence.zh: 这是同一模型和叶项读法内的形式组合，不是向可加的被汲取量或任意时序模型的通用转换。

history.zh: 2026-10-14，整合 I3（Ren：“a lot proofs are probably not integrated”）：在脊柱上陈述，附加一个假设。新的核心模块 Becoming.Composition（只导入 Becoming.Likeness）加入一配置把两配置作为部分共同持有的关系（JointFrame），以及联合检验、联合相同、紧致、嵌套计划与足迹；Becoming.CompositionBridge 把 ExplanatoryJointness 与 ExplanatoryFootprints 读作实例。在部分可提升的描述处实现的计划，其叶所汲取者合起来无重复，且在所描述整体的足迹之内（JointPlan.supports_of_image）；code_plan_has_global_support 即提升与此定律的组合，在模型检验稳定处于脊柱上成立（code_plan_has_global_support_of_stable），稳定只用于提升一步，排中律给出之。公理报告为空（草稿构建；回执随落地）。外围证明及其回执保持原范围。
history.en: 14 October 2026, integration I3 (Ren: “a lot proofs are probably not integrated”): stated on the spine, with one added hypothesis. The new core module Becoming.Composition, importing only Becoming.Likeness, adds the relation by which a configuration holds two configurations together as its parts (JointFrame), with joint tests, joint likeness, compactness, nested plans and footprints; Becoming.CompositionBridge reads ExplanatoryJointness and ExplanatoryFootprints as instances. Wherever a plan is realized at a description whose parts lift, what its leaves draw on, joined, repeats nothing and lies within the described whole's footprint (JointPlan.supports_of_image); code_plan_has_global_support is the lifting composed with this law and holds on the spine where the model's tests are stable (code_plan_has_global_support_of_stable), stability being used only by the lifting stage and given by excluded middle. Empty axiom reports (scratch build; the receipt comes with the landing). The periphery proof and its receipt keep their scope.
